# Make IML JSON schemas

Copied unchanged from Make's own Apps SDK (the "Make Apps Editor" VS Code
extension), `syntaxes/imljson/schemas`, at commit `6ff5f3dd9960ccbeb24de3beb1cca935de89eaa0` of
https://github.com/integromat/vscode-apps-sdk. MIT-licensed; see LICENSE.md.

The tests validate every section of the Sincerely Make app against these
before anything is uploaded, so a malformed section fails here, not in Make.
